title: HomeGuard Optional Endorsement Price List
content:
Price list for the three optional coverages of the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy — underground service line, home systems equipment breakdown and identity fraud expense — showing for each package the limit included in the package, the limit the endorsement provides when purchased, and the endorsement's annual premium.

## Underground service line

| Package | Included limit (USD) | Endorsement limit (USD) | Endorsement annual premium (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | 0 (not included) | 10000 | 24.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | 0 (not included) | 10000 | 24.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | 10000 | 10000 | 20.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | 0 (not included) | 10000 | 24.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | 10000 | 10000 | 20.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | 25000 | 10000 | 18.00 |

## Home systems equipment breakdown

| Package | Included limit (USD) | Endorsement limit (USD) | Endorsement annual premium (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | 0 (not included) | 50000 | 32.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | 0 (not included) | 50000 | 32.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | 50000 | 50000 | 28.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | 0 (not included) | 50000 | 32.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | 50000 | 50000 | 28.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | 100000 | 50000 | 25.00 |

## Identity fraud expense

| Package | Included limit (USD) | Endorsement limit (USD) | Endorsement annual premium (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | 0 (not included) | 25000 | 25.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | 0 (not included) | 25000 | 25.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | 25000 | 25000 | 20.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | 0 (not included) | 25000 | 25.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | 25000 | 25000 | 20.00 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | 50000 | 25000 | 20.00 |

## Notes to the price list

- An included limit is the limit the coverage carries within the package itself; 0 means the package does not include the coverage.
- An endorsement limit is the limit provided when the endorsement is purchased. It is the same on every package: 10000 for service line, 50000 for equipment breakdown and 25000 for identity fraud expense.
- The annual premium is the yearly price of the endorsement on that package.

## Reading the list — hypothetical cases

- A hypothetical HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced policy includes none of the three coverages. The service line endorsement on it provides 10000 at 24.00 a year; the equipment breakdown endorsement provides 50000 at 32.00 a year.
- A hypothetical HomeGuard HO-3 Premier policy already includes service line at 10000, equipment breakdown at 50000 and identity fraud expense at 25000 within the package.
